Description
ArchiveEntity

Represents the metadata of an archived file, including its ID, name, creation date, hash, path, MIME type, and extension.
ArchiveRepositoryJpa

ContextPropagationFilter
A filter that extracts request context information from HTTP headers and stores it in a ThreadLocal variable for the duration of the request.

Custom exception class to handle exceptions with custom messages and HTTP status codes.

FileController
Controller class for managing file operations such as saving files and retrieving file details.
FileDto
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling file-related information, including the file itself and its associated MD5 and SHA-256 hash values.
FileResponseDto
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for responding with file-related information, including file metadata such as UUID, hash values, file name, MIME type, file extension, and the actual file content represented as a byte array.
FileSystemService

GetFileService
Service for retrieving file data by UUID, checking file integrity, and returning metadata.
HashService
Service for generating and verifying MD5 and SHA-256 hashes of files.
HeaderPropagationInterceptor
An interceptor that propagates headers from the RequestContext to outgoing HTTP requests made by RestTemplate or other HTTP clients.
